## Welcome

Hi! My name is Sofie Faircloth. I am a student at Santa Barbara City College. I am interested in psychology and criminology.

## A question I care about

Something I care about is why people make the choices they do. I care about this because people are often judged for the choices they make, but nobody seems to ask why they made those choices. This is why I want to go into criminal or forensic psychology.

## Something I have learned with data

Something that using RStudio and data has taught me is how to compare variables to find correlations in data. This is really interesting to me because I am able to take specific variables from a dataset, put them into a plot, and see how they relate to each other.

[See my work on GitHub](https://github.com/SOFIEFAIRCLOTH)
